result.reason: The file conforms to every criterion in the specification. Top-level describe names the unit by module name ('create-review'); nested describes are when-clauses; each it states one observable outcome in plain language. Every it block contains exactly one expect, and compound shapes are asserted once with toMatchObject. Tests exercise only the public run function and observable store state via the injected in-memory collaborator; there are no spies, no mocks of honest in-memory collaborators, and no reach into module scope. Test data is built fresh inside each test via validInput() with per-test overrides, and the store is recreated in beforeEach so suites never depend on each other's state or ordering.
